definitions.explanation: Treating someone or something better than others, often through special benefits, privileges, or consideration. Used as a suru verb.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{優遇|ゆうぐう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{優遇|ゆうぐう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This company gives preferential treatment to employees raising children.

examples.japanese: ⟦{税制|ぜいせい}→税制：28854_zeisei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{優遇|ゆうぐう}{措置|そち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}→申請：04207_shinsei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: An application is required to receive preferential tax treatment.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used in business, government policy, and employment contexts. Often appears in discussions of tax benefits, employee benefits, and social welfare programs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {優遇|ゆうぐう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to give preferential treatment)
- {優遇|ゆうぐう}{措置|そち} (preferential measures)
- {優遇|ゆうぐう}⟦{税制|ぜいせい}→税制：28854_zeisei⟧ (preferential tax system)
- {優遇|ゆうぐう}⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧ (preferential interest rate)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{冷遇|れいぐう}→冷遇：15722_reiguu⟧: cold treatment, neglect — the opposite of {優遇|ゆうぐう}
